text: condition_number(), bkw_diagnostics() rvif_diagnostics() take method argument four possible values. default "WS": Let \(X\) design matrix (intercept included), \(\hat W\) IRLS weights convergence, let subscript \(ul\) mean “every column scaled unit Euclidean length”: None four centers data. deliberate: centering removes intercept column analysis, near-linear relationship intercept regressors (non-essential collinearity) can longer seen (Belsley et al. 1980), family/link combinations even possible – Gamma family canonical (inverse) link, \(\sqrt{\hat w_i}\,\hat\eta_i = 1\) every observation, centered, weighted design matrix exactly singular. Nitrogen reproduction article shows real data. things worth knowing: classical scale: condition_index \(\sqrt{\lambda_{max}/\lambda_{min}}\) (one thresholds 10, 30 100 refer ) condition_number ratio \(\lambda_{max}/\lambda_{min}\) . Gamma family log link IRLS weights identically 1, "WS", "MP" "X" coincide (happens Bodyfat application). happens Gaussian model identity link. rvif_diagnostics() calls rvif::rvifs() ul = TRUE, rescales matrix unit length . Hence "WS", "MP" "RAW" give RVIF; "X" (weights) differs. bkw_diagnostics(mod, method = "X") , model intercept, exactly VisCollin::colldiag(mod, add.intercept = TRUE). See comparison VisCollin.

title: Introduction to multiCollglm
text: ml_collinearity() implements diagnostic Lesaffre Marx (1993), compares sqrt(CN) original design matrix, condition_number(mod, method = "X"), sqrt(CN) IRLS-weighted information matrix method = "MP", distinguish ordinary collinearity among explanatory variables ML-collinearity: ill-conditioning instead arises combination response, fitted coefficients link function. computed natively; package needed. example Lesaffre Marx’s Lee cancer-remission model (TEMP expressed hundredths degree packaged data, hence factor 100), whose published \(\kappa_X = 190.78\) reproduced exactly (see also LeeCancer reproduction article): Following Lesaffre Marx (1993, Sec. 4.2), model flagged ml_collinearity = TRUE ratio sqrt(CN)_W / sqrt(CN)_X exceeds ratio_threshold (default 5) sqrt(CN)_W exceeds kappa_threshold (default 30) – high ratio , small sqrt(CN)_W, indicate ill-conditioned information matrix begin . Separately, sqrt(CN)_X > kappa_threshold flags ordinary collinearity among explanatory variables (collinearity_x); flags set ratio close 1, types collinearity simultaneously present. ml_collinearity() also glmnet/cv.glmnet methods, refitting active set exactly three diagnostics . See ?ml_collinearity full argument reference.
